item.description:
Nestled in the picturesque countryside of Llandilo, NSW 2747, this unique rural property offers a rare blend of spacious living and recreational possibilities. Spanning an impressive 11 clear acres, this expansive estate currently operates as a successful golf driving range, providing a unique opportunity for both relaxation and entertainment right in your backyard.

The heart of the property features a charming and spacious 5-bedroom, 2-bathroom home perfectly suited for families seeking tranquility and privacy. Each bedroom offers ample space and comfort, making it ideal for large families or those who love to entertain guests. The inviting living areas are bathed in natural light, offering spectacular views of the surrounding landscape.

Step outside and experience the true magic of this property — the expansive 11 acres (aprox) of level cleared land, beautifully maintained and currently serving as a serene golf driving range. Whether you're an avid golfer or seeking a lucrative business opportunity, this feature adds exceptional value and appeal to the property.

Additional features include ample parking space, storage sheds, and easy access to local amenities, schools, and transport links. Enjoy the peaceful rural lifestyle, proximality 55 km from Sydney.

This property is a rare find, offering endless possibilities to create your perfect rural retreat, establish a thriving business, or simply enjoy the luxurious blend of style, space, and sporting fun. Don't miss the opportunity to own this exceptional estate in the heart of Llandilo. Contact us today to arrange a private viewing.
